items.title: Interval Feature Transformation for Time Series Classification Using Perceptually Important Points
items.abstract: <jats:p>A novel feature reconstruction method, referred to as interval feature transformation (IFT), is proposed for time series classification. The IFT uses perceptually important points to segment the series dynamically into subsequences of unequal length, and then extract interval features from each time series subsequence as a feature vector. The IFT distinguishes the best top-k discriminative feature vectors from a data set by information gain.
